desc: 水瓶乳瓶双瓶组合叙事，玫瑰花瓣柔粉体系，早晚水乳两步保湿
name: 蔷薇露水乳保湿两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼看清双瓶组合，干净合规抢点击
一秒传达补水保湿的核心利益，承接主图点击
放大换季干渴、上妆卡粉的缺水痛点，引出产品
用清爽流动的水质质地特写证明肤感轻盈不黏
代入清晨梳妆台真实使用情境，强化早晚两步习惯
以同框同光的皮肤观感对比传达使用后的水润差异
俯视图解水乳两步顺序，消除怎么用的疑虑
低机位气势呈现水乳两件组合，让买家确认到手件数
俯瞰整套内含物与包装组合，降低到手预期差
深色收口制造反差，聚焦行动引导完成促单

style.backgroundSystem: seamless warm ivory #FBF6F0 and misty rose #F4DCD6 paper fields, pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust, deep rose-plum #6B2D4F reserved for the closing shot only
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and blank hairline label rails in the plum accent #6B2D4F only
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio lighting, large diffused front-left key, gentle falloff, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft floral premium skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm ivory #FBF6F0, misty rose #F4DCD6, deep rose-plum accent #6B2D4F and warm umber text #3E342C; warm soft studio lighting with a large diffused front-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line icon and hairline label style in the plum accent only; clean high-end skincare photography with flowing satin and fresh rose props; upright bottles at stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: upright bottles at stable scale; hero angle is a slight 3/4; macro and overhead shots vary rhythm
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm ivory paper #FBF6F0 and rose-mist board #F4DCD6, one polished white porcelain slab for macro work
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one family only
